instruction: Create the shared, React-free RSVP status module exactly as specified in design.md §4. Move ATTENDEE_STATUS_DOT and attendeeStatusLabel verbatim out of EventDetailsSection.tsx (class-name literals must be byte-identical). Add AttendeeStatusLike, the private ATTENDEE_STATUS_SEVERITY map, aggregateAttendeeStatus (non-mutating reduce, null for undefined/empty), ATTENDEE_AGGREGATE_LABEL, attendeeSummaryLabel(status,count), ATTENDEE_COUNT_DISPLAY_MAX and attendeeCountLabel. Re-export the AttendeeResponseStatus type from @core; do not redeclare it. No React import, no store access, no DOM.

instruction: Create the presentational AttendeeBadge component exactly as specified in design.md §4. Export ATTENDEE_BADGE_ATTRIBUTE = "data-attendee-badge" and AttendeeBadge({ className, count, status, style }). One aria-hidden, pointer-events-none span containing an 8px dot (size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full + ATTENDEE_STATUS_DOT[status]) and the capped count text; title = attendeeSummaryLabel(status, count). No hooks, no state, no interaction handlers. Follow EventRepeatIcon's doc-comment style.

no attendee name or email is accepted as a prop or rendered (D-5)
